business_problem: App login times at Baptist Health could be up to 3 minutes each, and for some apps, clinicians had to load roaming profiles on each device during a shift. Manual software installations and configurations were time-consuming.
solution_summary: Baptist Health built this solution on Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 11. App login times at Baptist Health could be up to 3 minutes each, and for some apps, clinicians had to load roaming profiles on each device during a shift. Manual software installations and configurations were time-consuming. Azure Virtual Desktop delivers secure virtual desktops and standardized work environments to end users. Windows 11 provides the managed endpoint experience used by staff. Baptist Health implemented Azure Virtual Desktop on Azure Stack HCI, integrated with Epic. It also began a migration to Windows 11 and deployed Azure Stack HCI for centralized management and visibility into its IT environment. Legacy workloads and user sessions are moved into managed Azure services where the application stack can be standardized, scaled, and operated from the cloud. The rollout also connects with EHR system so users can work inside existing operating processes.
